# Benchmark fixtures

Put the PDFs to benchmark here (`*.pdf`); they are git-ignored except the generated sample.
Recommended set, to compare strategies fairly:

1. `short-text.pdf` — a few pages of plain prose (lecture notes).
2. `long.pdf` — ~30 pages.
3. `tables-diagrams.pdf` — slides or a textbook chapter with tables/figures.
4. `scanned.pdf` — an image-only scan (expect `text-extract` to fail: no text layer).

`sample-cells.pdf` is generated by `go run ./cmd/genfixture` so the benchmark runs out of the box.

Run: `GEMINI_API_KEY=... make bench` (see Makefile), then record results in
`docs/adr/0005-generation-strategy.md`.
